meta.scope: Clarify S040 author-reported Table 3 dispersion without assigning an unsupported SD calculation unit

records.title: GIAFormer: A Gradient-Infused Attention and Transformer for Pain Assessment with EDA-fNIRS Fusion

searches.query: S040 Table 3 and Figure 6 caption dispersion statistic and LOSOV calculation unit

updates.производительность: Author-reported Table 3 metric/dispersion pairs: accuracy 90.51% +/- 9.33, F1 90.38% +/- 9.65, specificity 95.26% +/- 4.66; class TPRs 94.36% +/- 8.35 (No Pain), 88.97% +/- 15.46 (Low Pain), 88.21% +/- 13.49 (High Pain). Figure 6 caption labels plotted metric dispersion as standard deviations, but Table 3 does not define the statistic or calculation unit for its listed dispersion; do not interpret these values as SD across LOSOV folds.
updates.ограничения: Full publisher PDF body recovered from embedded page objects in a publisher-served artifact (SHA-256 8474bc90b239dcfcf970338cde2ff62629699e9aa0782e04c89ba661eb16a7dd); the active PDF page tree exposes only page 1. Results concern controlled acute experimental stimuli in 65 healthy people and 2,340 repeated segments. Table 3 reports metric/dispersion pairs; Figure 6 labels plotted metric dispersion as standard deviations, but Table 3 does not define the statistic or calculation unit for its values. LOSOV performance is participant-held-out within this cohort. No independent external cohort or probability calibration is reported. Dataset access is on reasonable request; the cited code repository did not expose the trained code/models in this check. This study does not validate chronic pain, ECAP, SCS treatment response or clinical deployment.
